# Rank Me Higher — Full Documentation

> Rank Me Higher is the AI-autonomous growth platform for local businesses — think "Lovable + Search Atlas for local business." The AI researches a business's market, plans its website, builds it in minutes with real photos and natural AI imagery, texts the owner progress, and puts the site live. Owners edit anything by chatting with the AI. One portal, one subscription. Built in Chicago.

## Company Overview

- **Name**: Rank Me Higher

## The Core Offer

**Get a FREE website that dominates Google — built by AI in minutes.**

The free build is a real build, not a mockup: the AI researches the market, plans the site, builds it, and texts the owner a live preview link. No credit card required. Going live on the business's own domain requires a subscription (see Pricing).

## What Is Live Today

1. **AI research → plan → build**: The AI studies the business, its area, and what customers search for, then builds a complete local-SEO-correct website in minutes.
2. **Real photos + natural AI imagery**: The site uses the business's real photos wherever available, filled out with natural AI imagery matched to the trade — no generic stock photos.
3. **SMS/email progress updates**: The owner gets texted and emailed as the AI works, ending with a live preview link (with consent; see Privacy).
4. **Chat editing**: Click any part of the site, say the change, and the AI makes it. Every edit is versioned and revertable.
5. **Hosting, SSL, custom domain**: All handled by the platform, included in every plan.
6. **Lead capture with instant delivery**: Every site captures leads and delivers them in seconds by SMS and email (webhooks available), with all leads logged in the client portal.
7. **One portal, one subscription**: Site, edits, and leads in one place.

## Platform Direction (Coming — Not Live Yet)

- Google rankings tracked inside the portal
- Request tasks that the AI just does
- Automatic Google Business Profile optimization
- Automated review generation

## Pricing

- **$99/mo** — Website live on your domain + hosting + SSL + chat edits + lead capture with instant delivery + client portal
- **$149/mo** — Everything in $99, plus automatic Google Business Profile optimization
- **$199/mo** — Everything in $149, plus a review generator with a dedicated business phone number and branded email at your domain

No long-term contracts; cancel anytime. The free preview build costs nothing and requires no card.

## What "Local-SEO-Correct" Means

Every website the AI ships includes, from the first build:

- **Consistent NAP**: name, address, and phone identical on every page
- **JSON-LD structured data**: schema Google can read for the business, services, and area
- **Honest hours and real information**: sites that match reality, which Google rewards
- **City and service pages**: dedicated pages for each service and area served
- **Fast, mobile-compact pages**: local searches happen on phones; pages are built lean

SEO is not a retainer or an add-on — it is how the platform builds every site.

## Pages / Services

### AI Website Builder (flagship)
**URL**: https://rankmehigher.com/services/websites
The AI researches, plans, and builds a complete local business website in minutes, texts the live preview, and handles hosting, SSL, and the domain. Editing is done by chatting with the AI.

### Local SEO
**URL**: https://rankmehigher.com/services/seo
Local SEO is built into every site the AI ships (see "Local-SEO-Correct" above). Platform direction: rankings tracked in the portal.

### Content & Ads
**URL**: https://rankmehigher.com/services/content-ads
The website is the asset every ad clicks to. The platform builds pages that convert ad traffic; ad campaigns are run for businesses on the platform, with spend going directly to the ad platforms.

### Google Ads
**URL**: https://rankmehigher.com/services/google-ads
Google search campaigns for platform businesses, landing on AI-built pages made to convert. The recommended order: free website first, ads after.

### Lead Capture & Delivery
**URL**: https://rankmehigher.com/services/outbound
Every site captures leads and delivers them instantly by SMS, email, and webhooks; all leads are logged in the portal. The $199/mo plan adds a dedicated business phone number and branded email.

### Google Business Profile Optimization (Local Map Booster)
**URL**: https://rankmehigher.com/localmapbooster
The Google Business Profile is half of local search; the website is the other half. The $149/mo plan pairs the AI-built website with GBP optimization. Platform direction: automatic GBP optimization and automated review generation ($199/mo tier).

## Businesses On The Platform

Published examples are Truck Clinic in Romeoville and QTA Tax in Oak Brook.

## Who It's For

Local service businesses of every trade: auto detailing and tint, cleaning, HVAC and mechanical, trucking services, repair shops, window cleaning, home services, and any local business that needs to be found on Google and never miss a lead.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is the free website actually free?**
A: Yes. The AI builds the complete site and texts a live preview link — no card required. Payment starts only when the site goes live on the owner's own domain, from $99/mo.

**Q: How long does the build take?**
A: Minutes. The AI researches the market, plans the site, and builds it, sending progress updates by text and email along the way.

**Q: How do I change something on my site?**
A: Chat with the AI — click anything, say the change. Every change is versioned and revertable. No tickets, no waiting on a designer.

**Q: Does it use my real photos?**
A: Yes, wherever you have them. Gaps are filled with natural AI imagery matched to your trade.

**Q: Is SEO extra?**
A: No. Every site ships local-SEO-correct: consistent NAP, JSON-LD schema, honest hours, city/service pages, and fast mobile pages — included in every plan.

**Q: What happens when someone submits a lead on my site?**
A: You're texted and emailed the details in seconds, and the lead is logged in your portal. Webhooks can push leads to your CRM. The $199/mo plan adds a dedicated business phone number.

**Q: Do you handle my domain and hosting?**
A: Yes — hosting, SSL, and custom domain connection are included in every plan.

**Q: Can I see my Google rankings?**
A: That's where the platform is going: rankings in your portal. Today, the platform ships a correctly built site and full lead visibility.

**Q: Do you run ads?**
A: Campaigns are run for businesses on the platform (Meta and Google), landing on their platform-built pages. The website comes first.

**Q: Do you work with businesses outside Chicago?**
A: Yes — the platform serves local businesses across the United States.

**Q: How do I get started?**
A: Take the free website quiz at https://rankmehigher.com/#free-website — or text (773) 572-4686.
